purpose: Preparation only. Bind qualified release digests before applying through the existing Coolify controller. This file contains no deployment action or credentials.

nbg.description: First fallback after Fly. Reserve memory for two containers during replacement on the existing 4 GB host.

finland.description: Second fallback after Nuremberg. Preserve existing shared applications and backup jobs; reserve two containers for replacement.

operation.deploymentMethod: Coolify Docker Image application on the existing controller
operation.start: Keep origin out of customer routing; pull the selected digest, verify source/architecture, start and qualify before enabling its pool.
operation.stop: Disable this origin in routing and verify another healthy origin; allow routing propagation, then SIGTERM and wait for completion within 45 seconds.
operation.rollback: Deploy the recorded compatible rollback digest through the same resource; no automatic database rollback.
operation.fixtureQualification: Use a separate synthetic database and no production credentials or public routes. The existing artifact smoke does not qualify native protocol, distributed delivery, or workers.
operation.workerActivation: The all-role expectation is conditional on the concurrent-worker review and isolated qualification. Do not start real workers merely to satisfy this profile.
operation.databaseBudget: Each process uses up to three query plus one health connections. Count every running origin and replacement; verify actual database capacity before starting overlap.
operation.logging: Retain verified bounded per-node logs. The installed Coolify single-container path does not support per-app JSON log options; do not change the shared Docker daemon to force a smaller cap.
